the development of an in vitro model system for the study of the mechanisms of androgen action on prostate cancer cells.
the development of a serum-free culture system for a human prostate cancer cell model and the characterization of the resultant subline.
the development of a serum-free, hormone-responsive, human prostate cancer cell model.
